name: nostalgia-theme
title: Nostalgia Theme
description: Mac OS 9 design tokens (--os9-* colors, bevel shadows, font stacks) and utilities (os9-raised, os9-inset, os9-window, os9-stripes, os9-focus-ring). Required by every retro-* component.

name: retro-label
title: RetroLabel
description: A Mac OS 9 styled label with Geneva 10pt default and Charcoal 12pt large size variants, built on Radix UI Label.

name: retro-button
title: RetroButton
description: A Mac OS 9 styled button with raised bevel effect, active/pressed state, and disabled styling.

name: retro-input
title: RetroInput
description: A Mac OS 9 styled text input with inset bevel effect, focus ring, and two sizes.

name: retro-radio
title: RetroRadio
description: A Mac OS 9 styled radio button group with 3D circular bevel effect, built on Radix UI Radio Group.

name: retro-tabs
title: RetroTabs
description: Mac OS 9 styled tabs with large/small sizes and raised bevel active state, built on Radix UI Tabs.

name: retro-progress
title: RetroProgress
description: A Mac OS 9 styled progress bar with inset bevel track and candy-stripe azul fill pattern.

name: retro-title-bar
title: RetroTitleBar
description: A Mac OS 9 styled title bar with striped drag region, close/collapse/zoom control boxes, and centered title text.

name: retro-slider
title: RetroSlider
description: A Mac OS 9 styled slider with rectangular raised bevel thumb and inset track, built on Radix UI Slider.

name: retro-checkbox
title: RetroCheckbox
description: A Mac OS 9 styled checkbox with inset bevel, checkmark and indeterminate (dash) states, built on Radix UI Checkbox.

name: retro-menu-bar
title: RetroMenuBar
description: A Mac OS 9 styled menu bar with horizontal strip, bevel highlights, azul active state, and dropdown menus with classic drop shadow.

name: retro-window
title: RetroWindow
description: A Mac OS 9 styled window frame with title bar, close/collapse/zoom controls, active/inactive states, and content area.

name: retro-select
title: RetroSelect
description: A Mac OS 9 styled select dropdown with raised bevel trigger, up/down chevron arrows, and azul-highlighted menu items, built on Radix UI Select.

name: retro-separator
title: RetroSeparator
description: A Mac OS 9 styled separator with classic beveled line effect: dark top/left pixel and light bottom/right pixel, built on Radix UI Separator.

name: retro-textarea
title: RetroTextarea
description: A Mac OS 9 styled textarea with inset bevel effect, focus ring, vertical resize, and two sizes.

name: retro-badge
title: RetroBadge
description: A Mac OS 9 styled badge with raised bevel effect, Geneva 9px font, and three color variants: default, accent (lavender), and azul.

name: retro-popover
title: RetroPopover
description: A Mac OS 9 styled popover with classic drop shadow, built on Radix UI Popover.

name: retro-toggle
title: RetroToggle
description: A Mac OS 9 styled toggle button with raised/pressed bevel states, built on Radix UI Toggle.

name: retro-card
title: RetroCard
description: A Mac OS 9 styled card with raised bevel effect, header with bevel separator, title, description, content area, and footer with action buttons.

name: retro-switch
title: RetroSwitch
description: A Mac OS 9 styled binary toggle switch with rectangular inset track, raised bevel thumb, and azul checked state, built on Radix UI Switch.

name: retro-tooltip
title: RetroTooltip
description: A Mac OS 9 Balloon Help styled tooltip with pale yellow background, rounded corners, and drop shadow, built on Radix UI Tooltip.

name: retro-hover-card
title: RetroHoverCard
description: A Mac OS 9 styled hover card with solid border and drop shadow, built on Radix UI Hover Card.

name: retro-alert
title: RetroAlert
description: A Mac OS 9 styled alert box with raised bevel effect, left accent border, and three variants: default, warning, and destructive.

name: retro-pagination
title: RetroPagination
description: A Mac OS 9 styled pagination component with raised bevel page buttons, active/pressed state, previous/next navigation, and ellipsis indicator.

name: retro-avatar
title: RetroAvatar
description: A Mac OS 9 styled avatar with beveled border, image support, fallback initials, and sm/default/lg size variants, built on Radix UI Avatar.

name: retro-skeleton
title: RetroSkeleton
description: A Mac OS 9 styled skeleton loading placeholder with dithered diagonal hatching pattern and optional pulse animation.

name: retro-chevron
title: RetroChevron
description: A Mac OS 9 styled chevron arrow (filled triangle) with configurable direction, two color variants, and two sizes.

name: retro-breadcrumb
title: RetroBreadcrumb
description: A Mac OS 9 Finder-style breadcrumb navigation with Geneva 10px text, azul links, right-pointing triangle separators, and ellipsis for collapsed paths.

name: retro-toast
title: RetroToast
description: A Mac OS 9 styled custom toast system with mini-window appearance, striped title bar, beveled close box, and auto-dismiss via useRetroToast hook.

name: retro-nav-button
title: RetroNavButton
description: A Mac OS 9 styled 16x16 navigation button with raised bevel, centered SVG arrow, and four directions: left, right, up, down.

name: retro-context-menu
title: RetroContextMenu
description: A Mac OS 9 styled context menu with right-click trigger, sub-menus, checkbox/radio items, keyboard shortcuts, and classic drop shadow, built on Radix UI Context Menu.

name: retro-dialog
title: RetroDialog
description: A Mac OS 9 styled modal dialog with overlay, OS9 window frame, striped title bar with close box, description area, and footer for action buttons, built on Radix UI Dialog.

name: retro-alert-dialog
title: RetroAlertDialog
description: A Mac OS 9 styled alert dialog with OS9 window shadow, striped title bar, caution icon, and modal behavior, built on Radix UI Alert Dialog.

name: retro-toggle-group
title: RetroToggleGroup
description: A Mac OS 9 styled toggle group with shared borders, raised/pressed bevel states, and single or multiple selection modes, built on Radix UI Toggle Group.

name: retro-table
title: RetroTable
description: A Mac OS 9 styled data table with raised bevel column headers, hover highlight, azul selected row, and Finder list-view appearance.

name: retro-sheet
title: RetroSheet
description: A Mac OS 9 styled sheet (slide-over panel) with side variants, striped title bar, close box, and overlay, built on Radix UI Dialog.

name: retro-scrollbar
title: RetroScrollbar
description: A Mac OS 9 styled scroll area with 16px wide/tall scrollbars featuring raised bevel thumb, inset track, and arrow navigation buttons at each end, built on Radix UI ScrollArea.

name: retro-navigation-menu
title: RetroNavigationMenu
description: A Mac OS 9 styled navigation menu with horizontal strip, azul active triggers, dropdown content with classic drop shadow, and lavender hover links, built on Radix UI Navigation Menu.

name: retro-accordion
title: RetroAccordion
description: A Mac OS 9 styled accordion with disclosure triangle, bevel separator, and collapse animation, built on Radix UI Accordion.

name: retro-collapsible
title: RetroCollapsible
description: A Mac OS 9 styled collapsible disclosure with rotating triangle indicator, Charcoal heading trigger, and indented Geneva content area, built on Radix UI Collapsible.

name: retro-dropdown-menu
title: RetroDropdownMenu
description: A Mac OS 9 styled dropdown menu with white background, classic drop shadow, azul-highlighted items, bevel separators, submenus, checkbox/radio items, and keyboard shortcut labels, built on Radix UI Dropdown Menu.

name: retro-theme-provider
title: NostalgiaProvider
description: A Mac OS 9 theme provider that injects all OS9 CSS variables and utility classes so consumers can use nostalgia-ui components without manual globals.css setup.

name: retro-typography
title: RetroText
description: Mac OS 9 typography: RetroText variants plus semantic RetroH1–H4, RetroP, RetroLead, RetroBlockquote, RetroList, RetroInlineCode, RetroLarge, RetroSmall and RetroMuted.

name: retro-toolbar
title: RetroToolbar
description: A Mac OS 9 styled toolbar with icon buttons, separators, and button groups. Includes RetroToolbar, RetroToolbarButton, RetroToolbarSeparator, and RetroToolbarGroup sub-components.

name: retro-aspect-ratio
title: RetroAspectRatio
description: A Mac OS 9 styled aspect ratio container with optional inset border, built on Radix UI Aspect Ratio.

name: retro-spinner
title: RetroSpinner
description: Mac OS 9 styled loading indicators: RetroSpinner (animated wristwatch cursor with rotating second hand) and RetroBeachBall (spinning pinwheel wait cursor with colored segments). Both support sm/default/lg sizes via cva variants.

name: retro-carousel
title: RetroCarousel
description: A Mac OS 9 styled carousel/slideshow with inset panel container, raised bevel navigation buttons with triangle arrow SVGs, and embla-carousel-react for smooth sliding. Supports horizontal and vertical orientations.

name: retro-input-otp
title: RetroInputOTP
description: A Mac OS 9 styled one-time password input with individual inset bevel character slots, blinking caret, focus ring, and group separators, built on input-otp.

name: retro-resizable
title: RetroResizable
description: A Mac OS 9 styled resizable panel group for split layouts with raised bevel handle, grip dots, and drag-darkening effect, built on react-resizable-panels.

name: retro-drawer
title: RetroDrawer
description: A Mac OS 9 styled bottom sheet / drawer with pull handle, OS9 window bevel, and overlay, built on vaul.

name: retro-form
title: RetroForm
description: A React Hook Form integration with Mac OS 9 styling. Provides RetroForm, RetroFormField, RetroFormItem, RetroFormLabel, RetroFormControl, RetroFormDescription, and RetroFormMessage components following the shadcn Form pattern.

name: retro-command
title: RetroCommand
description: A Mac OS 9 styled command palette (search interface) with inset search input, azul-highlighted items, keyboard shortcut labels, and modal dialog variant, built on cmdk and Radix UI Dialog.

name: retro-calendar
title: RetroCalendar
description: A Mac OS 9 styled date selection calendar grid with raised bevel navigation buttons, azul selected day, lavender hover and range states, built on react-day-picker v9.

name: retro-chart
title: RetroChart
description: Mac OS 9 styled charting components with Balloon Help tooltips, square legend indicators, inset bevel container, and Geneva typography, built on recharts. Provides RetroChartContainer, RetroChartTooltip, RetroChartTooltipContent, RetroChartLegend, RetroChartLegendContent, and RetroChartStyle.

name: retro-date-picker
title: RetroDatePicker
description: A Mac OS 9 styled date picker with inline text input (MM/DD/YYYY), calendar icon trigger button, and popover calendar dropdown, composed from RetroPopover and RetroCalendar.

name: retro-date-range-picker
title: RetroDateRangePicker
description: A Mac OS 9 styled date range picker with two inline text inputs, en-dash separator, calendar icon trigger, and a two-month popover calendar for range selection.

name: retro-combobox
title: RetroCombobox
description: A Mac OS 9 styled searchable select / autocomplete combobox with inset bevel trigger, search input, azul-highlighted items, checkmark selection indicator, and group headings, built on Radix UI Popover.

name: retro-data-table
title: RetroDataTable
description: A Mac OS 9 styled full-featured data table with column sorting, text filtering, pagination, row selection, and column visibility, built on @tanstack/react-table and existing RetroTable primitives.

name: retro-desktop
title: RetroDesktop
description: A Mac OS 9 styled full-viewport desktop layout with pinned menu bar (Apple logo + live clock), desktop area with optional dot-pattern wallpaper, and selectable desktop shortcut icons with 32x32 icon area and Geneva 9px labels.

name: retro-sidebar
title: RetroSidebar
description: A Mac OS 9 styled app shell layout with collapsible sidebar, context-driven open/closed state, menu items with azul active and lavender hover, keyboard shortcut (Cmd+B) toggle, and icon-only collapsed mode. Provides RetroSidebarProvider, RetroSidebar, RetroSidebarHeader, RetroSidebarContent, RetroSidebarFooter, RetroSidebarMenu, RetroSidebarMenuItem, RetroSidebarMenuButton, RetroSidebarGroup, RetroSidebarGroupLabel, RetroSidebarTrigger, and RetroSidebarInset.

name: retro-icons
title: RetroIcons
description: 21 pure-CSS/SVG Mac OS 9 icons (folder, document, Trash, alerts, Happy Mac, Sad Mac, bomb, user, memory, Finder, extension and more) with a name-based RetroIcon wrapper.

name: about-this-computer
title: About This Computer
description: Mac OS 9 About This Computer window with version, built-in/virtual memory, largest unused block and per-application memory bars.

name: boot-screen
title: Boot Screen
description: Mac OS 9 startup screen with Happy Mac, “Welcome to Mac OS” progress box and marching extension icons. Controlled or autoPlay; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

name: copy-progress
title: Copy Progress
description: The Finder “Copy” progress window with items remaining, current file, progress bar, Stop button and an indeterminate “Preparing to copy…” state.

name: login
title: Login
description: Mac OS 9 Multiple Users welcome window with a keyboard-navigable user list, password field and default Log In button.

name: retro-app-switcher
title: RetroAppSwitcher
description: The Mac OS 9 Application menu for the right end of the menu bar: frontmost app icon and name, Hide, Hide Others, Show All, and a checkmarked list of running apps.

name: retro-bevel-button
title: RetroBevelButton
description: Mac OS 9 Appearance Manager bevel button with small/normal/large bevels, icon above or beside the label, sticky toggle (aria-pressed) behaviour and an optional pop-up menu arrow.

name: retro-button-group
title: RetroButtonGroup
description: Joins RetroButtons, inputs and text into one Mac OS 9 control strip with shared borders. Horizontal or vertical, with RetroButtonGroupSeparator and RetroButtonGroupText.

name: retro-control-strip
title: RetroControlStrip
description: The Mac OS 9 Control Strip: a collapsible strip of module buttons with a ridged end tab and pop-up module menus. Exports RetroControlStrip, RetroControlStripModule and RetroControlStripTab (aliased ControlStrip, ControlStripModule, ControlStripTab).

name: retro-empty
title: RetroEmpty
description: A Mac OS 9 empty state (RetroEmpty, RetroEmptyHeader, RetroEmptyMedia, RetroEmptyTitle, RetroEmptyDescription, RetroEmptyContent) for empty folders, Trash and search results.

name: retro-field
title: RetroField
description: Mac OS 9 form layout primitives with shadcn Field API parity: RetroField (vertical/horizontal/responsive), RetroFieldLabel, RetroFieldDescription, RetroFieldError, RetroFieldGroup, RetroFieldSet (plain or etched OS9 group box), RetroFieldLegend, RetroFieldSeparator, RetroFieldContent and RetroFieldTitle. No form-library dependency.

name: retro-folder-tag
title: RetroFolderTag
description: Mac OS 9 folder tag: the tab of a pop-up window with a small icon and folder name, in active/inactive states, attached above or below its window.

name: retro-group-box
title: RetroGroupBox
description: Mac OS 9 primary/secondary group box: an etched frame whose title (text, checkbox or pop-up) interrupts the top border.

name: retro-icon-view
title: RetroIconView
description: A Mac OS 9 Finder icon view grid with click, shift and command selection, darkened selected icons with azul labels, arrow-key grid navigation, open on double-click/Cmd+O, and optional inline rename.

name: retro-input-group
title: RetroInputGroup
description: A Mac OS 9 inset text well combining an input or textarea with addons: RetroInputGroup, RetroInputGroupAddon (inline-start/inline-end/block-start/block-end), RetroInputGroupInput, RetroInputGroupTextarea, RetroInputGroupButton and RetroInputGroupText.

name: retro-item
title: RetroItem
description: A flexible Mac OS 9 list row: RetroItem (default/outline/muted, default/sm, asChild) with RetroItemMedia, RetroItemContent, RetroItemTitle, RetroItemDescription, RetroItemActions, RetroItemGroup, RetroItemSeparator, RetroItemHeader and RetroItemFooter.

name: retro-kbd
title: RetroKbd
description: Mac OS 9 keyboard keycaps (RetroKbd, RetroKbdGroup) with a raised bevel and Charcoal lettering, plus RETRO_KBD_KEYS for the command, option, shift and control glyphs.

name: retro-list-box
title: RetroListBox
description: Mac OS 9 inset list box with single or multiple selection, azul highlight, arrow/Home/End navigation, type-ahead and listbox/option semantics.

name: retro-little-arrows
title: RetroLittleArrows
description: Mac OS 9 little arrows stepper with press-and-hold repeat, plus RetroNumberField: an inset spinbutton field with min/max/step, keyboard stepping and controlled/uncontrolled value.

name: retro-native-select
title: RetroNativeSelect
description: A native <select> styled as a Mac OS 9 pop-up menu button with raised bevel and double-arrow box. Default and sm sizes, plus RetroNativeSelectOption and RetroNativeSelectOptGroup.

name: retro-placard
title: RetroPlacard
description: Mac OS 9 window placard: the raised status strip at a window's bottom-left, with a RetroPlacardButton pop-up variant.

name: retro-sonner
title: RetroToaster
description: Sonner toasts rendered as Mac OS 9 alert windows: striped title bar, close box, per-type alert icons and OS9 action/cancel buttons. Exports RetroToaster and re-exports sonner's toast().

name: retro-tree-view
title: RetroTreeView
description: A Mac OS 9 Finder list view / Folder List: data-driven tree with animated disclosure triangles, optional sortable column headers (Name, Date Modified, Size, Kind), single/multi azul selection, controlled or uncontrolled expanded/selected state, and full WAI-ARIA tree keyboard support with type-ahead.

name: sad-mac-404
title: Sad Mac 404
description: Full-page not-found screen with a pure-SVG Sad Mac, hex error codes and a Restart link home. Dark and light variants.

name: unexpectedly-quit
title: Unexpectedly Quit
description: The classic Mac OS 9 “application has unexpectedly quit” Stop alert with OK, plus a “Sorry, a system error occurred” bomb variant with Restart.

name: control-panel
title: Control Panel
description: Mac OS 9 Appearance control panel with Themes, Appearance, Fonts, Desktop, Sound and Options tabs built from group boxes, pop-ups, sliders, checkboxes, radios and little-arrows fields.

name: desktop-shell
title: Desktop Shell
description: Full Mac OS 9 desktop that fills its container: menu bar with clock and Application menu, desktop icons, overlapping draggable windows with click-to-front, and the Control Strip.

name: finder-window
title: Finder Window
description: Mac OS 9 Finder window with a sortable Name / Date Modified / Size / Kind list view, disclosure triangles, an icon view toggle, a status placard and a size box.

name: get-info
title: Get Info
description: Mac OS 9 Finder Get Info window with General Information, Sharing and Memory panes, label pop-up, comments, and Locked / Stationery Pad checkboxes.

name: installer
title: Installer
description: Mac OS 9 multi-step installer wizard: Welcome, Read Me, license with Agree / Disagree alert, destination disk, install progress and finish.

name: open-save-dialog
title: Open / Save Dialog
description: Mac OS 9 Navigation Services Open and Save dialog with a location pop-up, Shortcuts / Favorites / Recent buttons, a browsable file list, a Name field and New Folder button.
